extracted.name: Absolute Best Liver and Onions
extracted.description: This easy liver and onions recipe will make a liver lover out of the pickiest eaters! Soaking in milk and quick cooking guarantees tender results.
ingredient_lines: 2 large Vidalia onions, sliced into rings
2 cups all-purpose flour, or as needed
instruction_lines: Gently rinse liver slices under cold water and pat dry with paper towels. Place in a shallow dish; pour in enough milk to cover. Let stand while preparing onions, or set aside for longer if you have time. Soaking will remove any bitterness.

Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion rings; cook and stir in butter until tender and soft, about 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer onions into a bowl and set the skillet aside.
Place flour on a plate; season with salt and pepper. Remove the liver from the milk and discard the milk. Coat liver slices in flour mixture.
Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of butter in the same skillet; increase heat to medium-high and fry coated liver slices until lightly browned, about 3 to 4 minutes on each side.
Return onions to the skillet and reduce heat to medium; continue to cook until onions are heated through and liver is slightly pink inside, or longer to suit your taste.
